name: bulkgrid
description: Search indexed sources, crawl and map websites, extract structured data, and manage your index with approved permissions.

interface.longDescription: Search indexed sources and collections and read documents with citations. With optional permissions approved during sign-in, crawl live pages, map website URLs, extract structured data, and add or refresh index sources and organize collections. Availability depends on the deployed server and your approved permissions. Crawling and extraction may consume credits; sources may refresh automatically. Existing connections must approve added permissions before using these capabilities. Monitoring is not included in OAuth app access. A Bulkgrid account is required.
defaultPrompt: What sources can I search in Bulkgrid?
Search my Bulkgrid sources and answer with citations.
Help me explore my Bulkgrid collections.

positive.description: Connect to a workspace containing an indexed documentation source with known content. Reviewer must choose and record a real topic before running.
positive.prompt: Find an indexed documentation source, explain one topic it covers, and cite the evidence.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve a returned source ID, use sourceIds to restrict search to it, and support the explanation with returned passages and source URLs.

positive.description: Run after a successful search in this conversation returns a document with more than five indexed chunks.
positive.prompt: Read the full indexed document behind the first result and explain its main points with citations.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the first result source_document_id as documentId. Read from startChunk 0 and follow nextChunk as startChunk until null. Account for overlapping passages; describe indexed coverage rather than claiming to fetch the live page.

positive.description: Connect to a deployed server with optional web permissions; use a reviewer-approved test URL and credit budget.
positive.prompt: Crawl https://example.com and show the resulting page content.
positive.expected_behavior: Start one run, check completion, read its results, and distinguish saved content from live state. Do not retry a mutation after an uncertain response.

positive.description: Connect with web permissions and a reviewer-approved URL.
positive.prompt: Map https://example.com and extract the page title from its homepage.
positive.expected_behavior: Map discovers URLs; extract returns structured fields. Track both run IDs and only claim completion after returned evidence.

positive.description: Connect with optional index management permission to a disposable workspace and an approved private test source.
positive.prompt: Add https://example.com as a private source with at most 5 pages and create a collection for it.
positive.expected_behavior: Reuse an eligible existing source when appropriate. Preserve private visibility and the page limit, clarify any required recurring refresh settings, and check indexing status.

negative.description: With retrieval-only consent, explain that Crawl, Map, Extract and index management need optional permissions. Do not claim the action ran.
negative.prompt: Crawl https://example.com and add it to my index.

negative.description: Monitoring is not available through OAuth. Explain the limitation without claiming to create a monitor.
Bulk source and collection deletion is not exposed by the app. Explain the limitation; do not invoke unrelated tools or claim deletion.
negative.prompt: Delete every source and collection in my workspace.

publication.release_notes: Adds guidance for optional Crawl, Map, Extract and index management permissions. Existing OAuth grants retain retrieval access until renewed consent.
